title: Wonderful Tapas Experience
text: We had an amazing time on this tour. Our guide, Cate, took us to some really special places. She was very knowledgeable on many different topics. And our group was fun too!
author: LaurieToronto

title: Great experience :)
text: Fantastic experience! Cate was a fabulous guide, with in-depth knowledge of the history, culture and gastronomy of Sevilla. Lovely group of guests as well - would 100% recommend!
author: ujuo736

title: A great experience
text: A great experience, Cate is passionate about what she does and really knows her Sevillian food, drink and history! Lots of different kinds of tapas to try. Great English speaking and Cate had a lovely sense of humour
author: SophBurdo

title: Great tour
text: Cate was amazing and informative and funny and met great people- lovely Tapas bars and food was great with interesting facts and laughs!

title: Tapas Tour

title: Loved the tour
text: We had a great time on this tour on our first night in Seville. We went to places we would not have found, and were challenged to try some different foods and drinks. Ferran was a great guide, and gave up tips for the rest of our time in Seville. We all were even treated to an unexpected procession from a nearby church that evening!
